# Changes oasdiff v1.11.7 reports as breaking that are not (CI step 'No breaking API changes').
# #46 / PR #63: nullable request properties moved from anyOf [null, T] to type [T, "null"]. oasdiff reads
# that as removing null (it misreads OpenAPI 3.1 type arrays) and as adding the pattern that was inside
# the anyOf branch. The accepted values are unchanged. These lines only match that base -> head change,
# so they can be removed once it is on main.
PATCH /v1/events/{id} added the pattern '^https?://\S+$' to the request property 'externalUrl'
PATCH /v1/events/{id} added the pattern '^https?://\S+$' to the request property 'translations/additionalProperties/anyOf[subschema #2]/imageUrl'
PATCH /v1/events/{id} request property 'defaultLocationId' list-of-types was narrowed by removing types 'null' from media type 'application/json'
PATCH /v1/events/{id} request property 'externalUrl' list-of-types was narrowed by removing types 'null' from media type 'application/json'
PATCH /v1/events/{id} request property 'registration/capacity' list-of-types was narrowed by removing types 'null' from media type 'application/json'

PATCH /v1/events/{id} request property 'registration/reminderMinBefore' list-of-types was narrowed by removing types 'null' from media type 'application/json'
PATCH /v1/events/{id} request property 'translations/additionalProperties/anyOf[subschema #2]/imageAlt' list-of-types was narrowed by removing types 'null' from media type 'application/json'
PATCH /v1/events/{id} request property 'translations/additionalProperties/anyOf[subschema #2]/imageUrl' list-of-types was narrowed by removing types 'null' from media type 'application/json'
